title.zh: 参数估计、似然与贝叶斯更新

lead.en: Derive Bernoulli and Gaussian estimates, prove risk identities, normalise a beta update, and connect MAP penalties to stated noise and prior scales.
lead.zh: 推导 Bernoulli 与高斯估计，证明风险恒等式，归一化 beta 更新，并从噪声先验尺度推 MAP 惩罚。

prerequisites.en: Modules 16, 17, 23 and 24. Continuous parameters require derivatives and density integration even for discrete observations. Labs use only the Python standard library.
prerequisites.zh: 需模块 16、17、23、24。即使观测离散，连续参数仍需导数及密度积分。实验只用 Python 标准库。

en: Distinguish models, parameters, estimators, estimates and identifiability.
Construct likelihood and retain factors that depend on the fitted parameter.
Derive Bernoulli and Gaussian MLEs with boundary and existence checks.
Prove bias–variance MSE and sample-variance denominator identities.
Normalise beta–Bernoulli updates and interpret prediction and credible intervals.
Derive MAP coefficients, qualify coordinate dependence and diagnose reused evidence.
zh: 区分模型、参数、估计量、估计值与可识别性。
构造似然，保留拟合参数相关因子。
推 Bernoulli 与高斯 MLE，检查端点和存在性。
证偏差方差 MSE 及样本方差分母恒等式。
归一化 beta 更新，解释预测与可信区间。
推 MAP 系数，限定坐标依赖并诊断复用证据。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and identify each fixed and varying argument.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，识别固定与变化的自变量。

text.en: Retrieve model spaces and likelihood conventions.
text.zh: 检索模型空间与似然约定。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and derive all boundary cases and risk identities.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，推端点与风险恒等式。

text.en: Calculate likelihood estimates and the normalised posterior.
text.zh: 计算似然估计与归一化后验。

title.zh: 后验预测与 MAP 建模

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and compare likelihood and posterior summaries.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，比较似然与后验摘要。

text.en: Compare exact and empirical risk at two fixed rates.
text.zh: 比较两个真率下的精确与经验风险。

text.en: Repair underflow, omitted factors and reused data.
text.zh: 修复下溢、漏因子和复用数据。

text.en: Complete choices and write a qualified estimation report.
text.zh: 完成选择并写带条件估计报告。

text.en: Read Bayesian summaries and model-to-loss assumptions.
text.zh: 阅读贝叶斯摘要与模型到损失条件。

text.en: Complete the exit task and distinguish all uncertainty objects.
text.zh: 完成结业，区分各不确定性对象。
